scope: Restricted matrix-confined continuation of the four accepted LP2-A1 S8 paths to at most S11 with the LP2-A2 paired-bank mesh family at the default 0.45 mm seed spacing ONLY; unchanged LP1/LP2 numerics, BVP, SIF gates and signed MTS; per-case termination at the first non-MATRIX_ADVANCE classification or local numerical HOLD

sourcePins.definition: g2: sorted relative-path sha256 lines of matlab/g2/*.m and matlab/g2/vendor_p010_a14d8872/*.m; lp2, lp2a2, lp2a3: sorted "name sha256" lines of the folder *.m; SHA-256 of the newline-joined string (g2_lp1_digest)

parents.authority: accepted LP2-A1 campaign G2-LP2A-001 (PR #70, review 6056658077); the ORIGINAL S8 STATE is the authoritative parent (full-precision polyline, tangent, signed KI/KII); WP5 records are NOT parents
parents.terminalCandidateRule: the S9 forecast of g2_lp2_forecast from the S8 STATE under this policy must equal TERMINAL.candidate.polyline_mm of the accepted LP2-A1 chain bitwise (isequal)

meshTransition: S8 parents were solved with the LP1 mesh family (g2_kinked_join); S9-S11 use the LP2-A2 family (g2_lp2a2_join, 0.45 mm paired bank seeds). Eligibility of the new family rests on the WP5 fixed-S8 equivalence (qualificationEvidence), not on new S9-S11 comparisons; the parent S8 geometry/SIFs are not recomputed

qualificationEvidence.campaign: G2-LP2A2-EQ-001 activation A2 (GO 820efd4, revoked 886c230), outcome EQUIVALENT; replay closure VERIFIED_V2
qualificationEvidence.use: eligibility of the mesh family only; never a parent state and never an acceptance threshold for S9-S11

caps.informationOnlyForecast: S12 (geometry only, no admission, mesh or FEM; outside the campaign)

meshFamily.function: g2_lp2a3_mesh = g2_lp2a2_join(...,ExteriorOptions,[xo,{SeedSpacing_mm,0.45}]) + g2_lp2a2_pairing_audit (identical to rung 1 of g2_lp2a2_mesh)
meshFamily.fallbackRungs: NONE: a rung-1 failure stops the case (TERMINAL NUMERICAL_HOLD); no other seed spacing, also not for diagnostics of a live candidate
meshFamily.gates: inherited 34 kink-mesh gates (g2_lp1_audit), P1-P10 pairing audit, four-mask phase audit, owner map, actual-polygon clearance; T3 <= 40000, min angle >= 20 deg, neighbour ratio <= 1.8; 76 chords per circle; protected p010 core 3.0 mm, collar 3.3 mm, 64 sectors, q domains

ringProximityGuard.rule: min_i(||tip - c_i|| - R_ring - 15 mm) >= 1 mm for EVERY ring i, irrespective of activation; evaluated on the full-precision candidate tip BEFORE any admission or mesh; exactly 1 mm passes, below fails; no rounding
ringProximityGuard.objectTypes: active ring -> PHYSICAL_INTERFACE (INTERFACE_APPROACH), passive ring -> NUMERICAL_RING (PASSIVE_CONTOUR_APPROACH); a proximity stop is neither an interface encounter nor crack arrest

physics: unchanged LP1: g2_lp1_audit (kink auditor 34 gates, T3 budget, bank adapter, four-mask phase audit, phase map) -> g2_m4b_ring_activation(case mask) -> g2_m4b_sif_partial with G2_TRAJECTORY_POLICY_v1 gates (16 criteria) -> g2_mts_direction (status OK, stationarity <= 1e-12)

classification.function: matlab/g2/lp2a3/g2_lp2a3_classify.m (wraps the unchanged g2_lp2_classify, adds the ring-proximity guard)
classification.passiveContour: a candidate whose ONLY failing constraints are NUMERICAL_RING (passive ring contour) is PASSIVE_CONTOUR_APPROACH (LP2-A1 reported this as NUMERICAL_HOLD)
classification.failureClasses: g2_lp2a3_failure_class = g2_lp2_failure_class + LP2-A3 local identifiers (mesh rung-1 failure, pairing, actual-polygon clearance)

acceptance: a new state is accepted only after the unchanged inherited gates (34 mesh gates, pairing P1-P10, phase/owner, actual-polygon clearance, 16 SIF gates of g2_m4b_sif_partial, MTS status OK with stationarity <= 1e-12, positive KI) and verified record completion; WP5 criteria C1-C11 are fixed-S8 cross-family comparisons and are NOT acceptance thresholds; there are no archived S9-S11 states to compare with

authorization.activation: GO file only, committed directly on the reviewed head (validator: ancestor + HEAD~1 == approvedHead + sole changed file, via g2_lp2a2_git)

resources.memoryTiming: g2_lp2a2_eq_memgate(7) immediately before each admission (failure before the state folder exists: pre-admission memory HOLD, global) and again immediately before each solve (failure after admission: global HOLD); the inherited 5 GiB guard of g2_lp1_admit_state and of the solve is unchanged; no automatic retry

stopRules: per case: stop at the first candidate that is not MATRIX_ADVANCE (terminal record, no mesh, no solve)
per case: stop at the first local numerical HOLD (rung-1 mesh failure, audit, pairing, phase, actual clearance, SIF gates, MTS) with TERMINAL NUMERICAL_HOLD; accepted prefix preserved; never retried
per case: CAMPAIGN_LIMIT_REACHED after an accepted S11 (an S12 candidate is forecast for information only)
global: source, policy, authorization, memory, record/ledger integrity or any unexpected error stops the whole campaign with a ledger HOLD; partial records preserved; no resumption
at most 3 admissions per case and 12 in total; no retry, no resumption, no adaptive step, no guide reduction, no passive-ring crossing, no fallback seed spacing

analysis.quantities: G, J, signed KI/KII, KII/KI, local MTS, global heading, signed lateral tip offset relative to H, tip-to-ring circle, guide-to-ring gap, segment clearance, phase activity, mesh/solver diagnostics, terminal reason, last accepted state
analysis.matching: only accepted arclengths s = 25.4 + 4k common to the compared chains; no interpolation or extrapolation

excluded: changes to historical sources, policies, records or archives
